$comment: Single source of truth for schema versions that both the backend and the Godot client stamp onto data. Backend code reads this file; scripts/validate-content/validate.mjs's validateSchemaVersionParity() asserts the GDScript constants still agree (SY-12 — the ClientVersionParityTests suite this comment used to name was removed; see CORE_GAMEPLAY_REVIEW.md §119), so the two cannot drift silently.

characterState.note: Saves the backend creates must carry the same version the client's migrator considers current, or every server-issued default state looks like an ancient save that needs migrating.
